# fix-lu4-disconnect-win

Lu4 Windows Ethernet disconnect fix — Realtek NIC power-save/offload (NOT ISP/white IP).

## Scripts (exactly 2)

- Apply-Lu4EthernetNic.ps1 — known-good: EEE/Green OFF, PnPCapabilities=24, LSO/RSC/checksum OFF, SelectiveSuspend/IdlePowerDown OFF, ASPM=0
- Rollback-Lu4EthernetNic.ps1 — typical defaults back (may restore disconnect)

No -Test, no -WhatIf. Run elevated. Win10 = Win11.

## Evidence

Same PC/network: USB WiFi OK, Ethernet FAIL before Apply; Ethernet OK after Apply.

## Success

E-Net OFF, Ethernet → Black → Recommended → Black in Servers → OK only → character select; :9971 Established ≥ 20s.

## Files

README.md (humans) · AGENTS.md · settings.known-good.json · settings.rollback-defaults.json
